Pixaroma Gold Standard — Central Human Control Desk

Everything you normally change is now collected in the five labelled panels directly below this guide.

  1. A — Prompts & Tags: write one quick prompt or prepare the ten-prompt batch.
  2. B — Krea AI: edit the optional image-prompt enhancer.
  3. C — Krea Settings: choose resolution, two sampler seeds and image LoRAs.
  4. D — MiniMax H3: direct the motion, set duration, first-frame size and seed, then choose Base or Turbo.
  5. E — Master Switches: select Quick/Batch, truly enable or bypass Krea AI, choose optional still outputs, and enable H3 video.

The processing graph remains below. Defaults are still Quick Prompt, Krea AI OFF, H3 OFF, and H3 Base Quality.

nodes.title: 6C. GOLD PATH — SeedVR2 Restore to 2048 px

Why this is the gold path

RCAS is applied only after SeedVR2 at a restrained 0.75. RTX remains available as the speed benchmark.

nodes.title: E3 — OPTIONAL STILL OUTPUTS: Mute / Run

rows.label: old rural churchyard
rows.text: A moonlit path winding through an old rural churchyard, no people, no animals. Bare trees lean over weathered gravestones and a small stone church sits partly obscured in the mist. Wet leaves and puddles glisten on the path, catching cold silver moonlight, while one small amber-lit window glows softly from the church. Moody autumn stillness, deep shadows, gentle fog, 19th-century nocturne oil painting, painterly and atmospheric

rows.label: wooden bridge deep in an autumn forest
rows.text: A narrow moonlit footpath crossing a small wooden bridge deep in an autumn forest, no people, no animals. Tall bare trees rise on both sides, their branches tangled against a deep blue-black sky. Wet fallen leaves cover the ground, and a dark stream passes beneath the bridge, reflecting silvery moonlight. Thin mist hangs low between the trunks, with a faint warm glow from a distant unseen cottage far beyond the trees. Quiet melancholy, Victorian nocturne atmosphere, painterly oil texture, poetic realism

rows.label: moonlit country lane
rows.text: A lonely moonlit country lane bordered by hedges and tall dark trees, no people, no animals. An old wooden gate stands slightly open beside the muddy lane, and the wet ground reflects pale moonlight in scattered puddles. Bare branches arch overhead, low mist drifts across the road, and a distant farmhouse window glows faintly through the haze. Quiet rural melancholy, Victorian nocturne mood, cool blue shadows with subtle amber warmth, painterly oil texture

rows.label: overgrown Victorian walled garden
rows.text: A moonlit path through an overgrown Victorian walled garden, no people, no animals. Dark trees and tangled shrubs crowd around a narrow wet path lined with fallen copper leaves. Moss-covered brick walls fade into soft mist, and an old iron gate stands in the distance beneath silver moonlight. A faint warm light glows from a small garden house beyond the gate. Atmospheric, reflective, autumnal, poetic realism, painterly nocturne oil painting,

rows.label: forest beside a still pond
rows.text: A moonlit path at the edge of a forest beside a still pond, no people, no animals. Tall bare trees frame the scene, their reflections dissolving in the dark water. Wet earth, fallen leaves, and shallow puddles catch the silver light of the moon, while thin mist drifts across the pond and between the trunks. Far in the background, a small cottage window glows warmly through the haze. Quiet melancholy, deep blue-black night, soft amber contrast, Victorian nocturne atmosphere, painterly oil texture

rows.label: winter forest after fresh snowfall
rows.text: A deserted moonlit path through a winter forest after fresh snowfall, no people, no animals. Tall bare trees rise on both sides, their dark trunks and branches dusted with snow. The narrow path is half-covered in white, with icy patches reflecting cold silver moonlight. Thin mist hangs between the trees, and a faint warm light glows from a distant cottage barely visible through the haze. Quiet stillness, deep blue-black night, painterly nocturne oil painting, poetic realism

rows.label: ruined modern city square
rows.text: A ruined modern city square after rain at night, no people, no animals. Broken office buildings, abandoned cafés, cracked paving stones, rusted street furniture, dead trees, and shallow puddles reflecting moonlight. Low mist hangs across the square, and one distant warm window glows faintly through the darkness. Quiet melancholy, post-apocalyptic urban decay, painterly nocturne atmosphere

rows.label: ruins of an old abbey
rows.text: A moonlit path leading through the ruins of an old abbey, no people, no animals. Broken stone arches and crumbling walls stand among tall bare trees, with wet leaves scattered across the ground and shallow puddles reflecting pale moonlight. Low mist drifts through the ruined cloisters, and one distant amber light glows from a small keeper’s house beyond the ruins. Quiet melancholy, Victorian nocturne atmosphere, painterly oil texture, deep shadows and soft silver light

rows.label: canal towpath in an old industrial town
rows.text: A moonlit canal towpath in an old industrial town, no people, no animals. The narrow wet path runs beside still dark water, with brick warehouses and iron railings fading into soft mist. Reflections shimmer in the canal, bare trees and old lamp posts stand along the path, and a few distant windows glow warmly through the haze. Quiet melancholy, Victorian night atmosphere, painterly nocturne oil painting, cool silver moonlight with subtle amber warmth

rows.label: Victorian city square after rain
rows.text: A moonlit Victorian city square after rain, no people, no animals. Wet cobblestones reflect the glow of gas lamps, and tall dark buildings rise around the square beneath a deep blue-black sky. Bare tree branches edge the scene, while light mist softens the distance and one warmly lit window glows from an upper floor. Quiet nocturne mood, reflective surfaces, poetic realism, painterly oil texture, soft amber light against cool shadows

nodes.title: E2 — KREA AI ENHANCER: TRUE OFF / ON
A3 — PIXAROMA TAG GUIDE
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

Mix ideas with Pixaroma tags

Tags work in the Quick Prompt and in the AI Prompt idea box. When AI is ON it adds *Lighting and *Visual style to whichever source the Multi-Prompt switch selected.

  • @name inserts one saved tag.
  • *Category chooses a random entry from that category.
  • #list chooses a random line from a saved list.

Turn AI OFF in the control panel for a true bypass: the selected prompt passes through without running the AI node.

aiPromptState.formula: Rewrite the supplied idea as one polished Krea 2 image prompt. Preserve the subject and intent. Add coherent composition, lighting, atmosphere and material detail. Return only the final image prompt, with no commentary.

nodes.title: E4 — MINIMAX H3 VIDEO: Mute / Run

aiPromptState.idea: Create one restrained, physically plausible action that develops naturally from the first frame. Prefer one continuous shot with small, slow camera movement. Preserve identity, clothing, composition, lighting, visible text and spatial relationships.
aiPromptState.formula: Rewrite the wired Krea image prompt and the supplied rendered image as a MiniMax H3 I2VA prompt for a 5.17-second video (124 frames at 24 fps). The supplied image is <Picture 1>, the exact first frame at 0.00 seconds. Return only the finished H3 prompt, beginning exactly with: For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced. Then leave one blank line and provide, in this exact order: integrated_multimodal_description, overall_soundscape, non_diegetic_music. In Shot 1, establish the style and composition from <Picture 1>, then describe a coherent action onset, continuous physical development, camera motion and a natural end state. Preserve subject identity, clothing, colours, important objects, readable text and spatial relationships. The first shot has no timestamp. If a later cut is genuinely necessary, number it sequentially and use a strictly increasing timestamp within 5.17 seconds. Do not invent dialogue, lyrics, extra people or changing on-screen text unless the source explicitly requires them. Write 1 to 4 concrete soundscape sentences. Use non_diegetic_music: N/A unless music is explicitly useful. No analysis, headings outside the required fields, alternatives or commentary.

nodes.title: 8B. H3 PROMPT MONITOR — Exact Audiovisual Prompt
8G. Load H3 Conditioning Encoder — Not the AI Writer
MINIMAX H3 BRANCH — BASE / TURBO GUIDE
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

Optional Krea → MiniMax H3 branch

  1. The raw decoded Krea Pass 2 image becomes H3's exact first frame.
  2. The second AI Prompt Pixaroma sees that frame and writes the H3 I2VA audiovisual prompt.
  3. BASE QUALITY preserves the original 20-step, CFG 1, res_multistep + simple path.
  4. TURBO QUALITY applies minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600 at strength 1.0 and uses 8 steps, CFG 1, Euler + Beta.
  5. The Pixaroma path selector is lazy: only the chosen sampler branch runs. It never renders both.

Use the upper H3 Group Switch to enable the whole video section. The path selector defaults to Base Quality. Choose Turbo for the faster few-step route; Turbo reduces total steps rather than the cost of each step.

nodes.title: D5 — H3 QUALITY PATH: BASE / TURBO
D7 — H3 FIRST FRAME: PASS 1 / GOLD PASS 2
F2 — MODE GUIDE & MANUAL OVERRIDES
widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

Six operating modes

  1. Quick Draft: one fast 768 px Pass 1 image.
  2. Prompt Exploration: the ten-prompt Pixaroma batch, AI-enhanced, at draft quality.
  3. Gold Still: full 1024 px double-sampler image finished through SeedVR2.
  4. H3 Preview: Krea Pass 1 becomes the first frame; MiniMax uses the Turbo LoRA and 8-step route.
  5. H3 Final: refined Pass 2 becomes the first frame; MiniMax uses the 20-step Base route.
  6. Comparison Lab: saves Pass 1, Pass 2, RCAS, RTX and SeedVR2 outputs plus both Pixaroma comparisons.

Choose a mode first, then edit prompts, tags, seeds or LoRAs. The existing switches remain available as manual overrides.
